summary: Complete manual retrospective annotation preserving false initial weight claim, actual faulty dial observation, corrected measurements, considered dishonest alternative, disclosed fault, fulfilled physical scale return and uncompleted future plans.

ambiguities.issue: The narrative treats the corrected 1.75-kilo measurement as order mass despite weighing the paper bag too. Bag mass/tare is unspecified; no engineering correction is invented.
Three small apples correct the order. Their individual masses and whether any earlier apples were swapped are not specified.
Scale is explicitly returned to Boulos. Final pie beside scale establishes co-location, not a second loan, transfer back to Mina, or exact final stall location.
Bus boarding and grandson arrival/meal remain expected, not observed, even though Dutta later returns with pie.
Cleaned is linked to the narrated leaf removal; no additional washing or unreported mechanical repair is asserted.
Grin, frown, hot cheeks and first position on tomorrow’s list are concrete evidence; named emotions and a permanent trust or competence trait are not certain.

feature_gaps.meaning: instrument indication versus object measurement versus false quantity claim
feature_gaps.resolution: Existing quantity_total/comparison objects retain measure_kind, phase, source scope and evidence. Do not conflate a true reading observation with a false mass assertion.
Document missing mass premise; no new field or inferred numeric bag tare is needed.

prompt_feedback: Retain observation truth separately from the property inferred from a faulty instrument; later correction does not erase earlier dial motion.
In quantity-change stories distinguish the initial measured state from a later physical correction; neither should overwrite earlier evidence.
A scale that says more is a figurative instrument reading, not a speaking agent.
Nested private alternatives and attributed reports need their own scoped content; no-one-would-know is not an actual knowledge claim about all characters.
Final co-location does not establish a new loan or unmentioned transfer after an explicit return.
coverage_notes: Every one of 714 words has manually specified contextual POS and lemma. All 1,024 catalog definitions were available and previously reviewed, with used meanings consulted during annotation. Supported sparse entity, event, grammar, measurement, spatial, possession, mental, speech, scope and evidence fields are applied without a coverage quota. Agreed trial extensions only. Whole-story retrospective, no causal filtering or API.
